newsitem.title: USA: Mazel Stores Inc Q3 proforma net rises.
newsitem.headline: Mazel Stores Inc Q3 proforma net rises.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended

(1) The reported pro forma financial data for the three months and nine months ended Oct. 31, 1995, reflect the combination of: (i) the Mazel wholesale operation; (ii) the Ohio retail operation (through October 1995); and (iii) the Peddlers Mart.

(2) Pro forma as adjusted data gives effect to the company's initial public offering as of the beginning of all periods presented, and includes the combination of:(i)the Mazel wholesale operations; (ii)the Odd Job retail operations; and (iii)the Peddlers Mart retail store, as if the combination of entities had occurred at the beginning of all periods presented. Pro forma as adjusted data exclude certain non-recurring charges, and give effect to the use of proceeds resulting from the company's 2,960,100 share initial public offering, as well as certain adjustments to compensation expense.
(3) Q3 and nine months 1995 net includes $1.6 million charge from a loss on the disposal of the Ohio retail operation.
(4) Q3 and nine months 1995 net includes charge for litigation expenses of $500,000.
